title: Morning high tide is the next test
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: The National Weather Service says the 8:14 a.m. high tide could reach 10.5 feet, about a foot lower than tonight's peak. Expect flooding again on Front Street and the Causeway approach.

title: Outages climb past 9,000
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: Merrow Electric now reports 9,180 customers without power, most south of Water Street and on Gull Island. The utility says restoration will start once water recedes from the substation on Dock Road.

title: Mayor: 'Stay home, stay off Front Street'
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: Mayor Teresa Vance said at a briefing that crews had rescued four people from cars on Water Street. No injuries were reported. 'If you are safe where you are, stay there,' she said.

title: Warming center open at Merrow High
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: The gym at Merrow High School, 400 Highland Ave., is open overnight with cots, food and charging stations. Pets are welcome. About 60 people had arrived by 9:30 p.m.

title: Correction: the tide peak was 11.4 feet
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: An earlier update said the tide peaked at 11.9 feet. The Coast Guard pier gauge recorded 11.4 feet at 7:52 p.m. We regret the error.

title: Tide peaks, third highest on record
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: The tide gauge at the Coast Guard pier peaked at 11.4 feet at 7:52 p.m., behind only the Blizzard of 1978 and the October 2017 storm.

title: Water over the seawall at Front Street
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: Waves are breaking over the seawall between the ferry terminal and Dock Road. Water is about a foot deep at Front and Water streets.

title: Causeway closed in both directions
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: Police have closed the Causeway at the drawbridge and at Harbor Road. Use Highland Avenue to get to the north side.

title: Last ferry leaves Gull Island
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: The ferry authority suspended service after the 5:30 p.m. run. It will reassess at 6 a.m. Sunday.

title: Storm warning upgraded
story: Nor'easter floods the Causeway, strands ferries and cuts power to 9,000
body: The National Weather Service upgraded the coastal flood watch to a warning and moved the peak earlier, to the evening high tide.
